project_title: FolgaSmart - Escala Inteligente de Folgas para PMEs

typography.font_family_heading: Cabinet Grotesk, Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, sans-serif

spacing_and_layout.bento_strategy: High Density Dashboard Mode B with custom Weekly Calendar Grid matrix
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for status badges and buttons, rounded-full for avatars/pills

key_components_structure.name: Header & Scale Switcher
key_components_structure.description: Sticky navigation with brand name 'FolgaSmart', quick scale mode selector (6x1 vs 5x2 Preview toggle), stats pill (Funcionários Ativos, Cobertura em Dias de Pico), CTA buttons (Exportar PDF/CSV, Novo Funcionário, Importar CSV).

key_components_structure.name: Customer Movement Peak Bar/Dashboard
key_components_structure.description: Visual banner showing daily customer traffic intensity (Histórico de Movimento). Shows high-movement days clearly flagged with warning badge & flame icon (ex: Sexta-feira & Sábado - PICO MÁXIMO). Allows quick slider / manual adjustment or file import.

key_components_structure.name: Weekly Schedule Matrix Grid (Funcionários x Dias)
key_components_structure.description: Core operational view. Columns = Seg, Ter, Qua, Qui, Sex, Sáb, Dom + Resumo da Semana. Rows = Employees (with Avatar, Nome, Cargo, Setor). Cells = Status (TRABALHA vs FOLGA). Allows click-to-edit override, highlights shift compliance alerts, and displays coverage counters at column bottoms.

key_components_structure.name: Employee Management Panel & Modal
key_components_structure.description: CRUD form and tabular view for employee list (Nome, Cargo, Setor, Preferência de Folga). Includes manual input & CSV drag-and-drop parser.

key_components_structure.name: Export & Print Drawer/Modal
key_components_structure.description: Formato limpo pronto para impressão do mural da empresa ou download CSV/PDF.

Proprietária de cafeteria sorrindo em seu estabelecimento

motion_and_effects.micro_interactions: Smooth transition on day-off toggle, staggered entry for calendar rows, subtle pulse glow on high-movement peak day indicators, slide-over drawer for cell edits.
motion_and_effects.hover_contrast_rule: Every hover state must explicitly define text color (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application interface is entirely in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).

Avoid purple/violet gradients or forbidden colors like #7351B7 or teal #1B93A4. Use rich dark slate/obsidian structural tones, warm sandstone light background, and energetic high-visibility red/amber accents for peak movement alerts.
Ensure all interactive elements and data fields include 'data-testid' attributes as declared.
Implement seamless support for both 6x1 scale (1 folga por semana) and 5x2 scale preview.
Provide CSV movement file upload with sample download option, plus manual peak movement day toggles.
Provide automatic scale generation algorithm with instant recalculation based on customer traffic peak flags.
Allow manual cell click overrides with conflict warning badges.
Use clean Sonner toast notifications for actions (Escala gerada com sucesso, Funcionário adicionado, CSV importado).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Use precise, non-generic typography paired with high-contrast data indicators.
Layered shadows and 1px crisp borders for clear grid separation.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
